6.speaker: Narrator
6.text: Since my daughter married him, the couple had been traveling constantly between Pales and Porte Drazon. The Palesian authorities were working hard with our government to realize our plans for unity.

10.speaker: Narrator
10.text: The grand Rizia-Pales reunion was right around the corner. Preparations were complete, our teams were cooperating and the marriage between Vina and Axel seemed to be going well. It wasn't a distant dream anymore.

11.speaker: Narrator
11.text: The only thing that was left was Duke Reinhart's complete approval.

12.speaker: Narrator
12.text: On one of their visits, we decided to take a break and visit my hometown in Monqiz.
12.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Lucita_Married"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Lucita_Arrested"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Lucita_Executed"] == false) == false

13.speaker: Narrator
13.text: We were on the picturesque beach of Monqiz, sitting in front of a cafe run by distant Toras relatives in a secluded corner of the sandy shores.

14.speaker: Axel Reinhart
14.text: "It's refreshing being here, away from the court's rigidity. Life's simpler rhythms have a charm of their own."

15.speaker: Narrator
15.text: We were on the picturesque beach of Monqiz, sitting in front of a cafe run by distant Toras relatives in a secluded corner that hadn't been invaded by Sordish tourists yet.

19.speaker: Narrator
19.text: My eyes were on Vina as she was taking a stroll on the beach, talking to the locals she encountered. She seemed to be immensely popular here.
19.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Lucita_Married"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Lucita_Arrested"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Lucita_Executed"] == false) == false

20.speaker: Axel Reinhart
20.text: "Tremendously, actually. We both think this was the right decision."

22.speaker: Player_Romus
22.text: "Look at her, Axel. I feel like she's more at home here than in any palace or court."

23.speaker: Player_Romus
23.text: "Tell me. Is the marriage faring well?"

24.speaker: Player_Romus
24.text: "I'm glad everything is going great between the two of you. I hope it stays that way for your sake."

25.speaker: Axel Reinhart
25.text: "Of course we're still working out the particulars of our marriage arrangement. But we make a good team, Vina and I."

26.speaker: Axel Reinhart
26.text: "Perhaps so. She definitely has a spirit too vast for the confines of stone walls."

28.speaker: Axel Reinhart
28.text: "To be honest, I don't think I could manage the preparations for our reunion without her help."

29.speaker: Axel Reinhart
29.text: "To be honest, it's your daughter who's given me a fresh perspective on life these days."

33.speaker: Narrator
33.text: Just then, the waiter of the cafe approached us to ask what we would like to drink. Axel turned to him and spoke.
33.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Lucita_Married"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Lucita_Arrested"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Lucita_Executed"] == false) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Pabel_RelationshipPublic"] == true) == false)

40.speaker: Narrator
40.text: The waiter quickly brought a bottle of Erlory Maroon whiskey as a recommendation, and started talking about how smoky and delicious it was.

41.speaker: Axel Reinhart
41.text: "What is the recommendation of the house?"

42.speaker: Narrator
42.text: The waiter quickly brought over a bottle of Lespian wine, 'Chateau de Falenco 1934', and started talking about its complex flavors.

43.speaker: Narrator
43.text: The waiter quickly brought a bottle of Cantuavo as his recommendation, and started talking about its exquisite taste.

47.speaker: Axel Reinhart
47.text: "Cantuavo? Oh, yes, please. Rizians know how to make their wine."

48.speaker: Axel Reinhart
48.text: "Lespian wine in Rizia? What has the world come to?"

49.speaker: Axel Reinhart
49.text: "With all due respect, in all my years working with Lespia, I've had enough of that. I'd prefer something authentically Rizian. Cantuavo, perhaps?"

50.speaker: Narrator
50.text: He laughed as he dismissed the bottle with a wave of his hand.

51.speaker: Narrator
51.text: The waiter quickly explained it was the main choice of the wealthy Sordish tourists who visited the area.

52.speaker: Axel Reinhart
52.text: "Oh, of course. Only a northerner with no culture would look at Lespian products and think they're fancy."

53.speaker: Axel Reinhart
53.text: "Oh, I don't want whiskey. If I wanted hard liquor, I'd go with something Valgish or Galmish."

54.speaker: Narrator
54.text: He laughed as he dismissed the bottle with a wave of his hand.

55.speaker: Axel Reinhart
55.text: "I'll have a Cantuavo, if you have any."

56.speaker: Narrator
56.text: He looked at me to see if I would have the same.

57.speaker: Player_Romus
57.text: "An excellent choice. I'll have the same."

61.speaker: Narrator
61.text: The waiter nodded and brought us our drinks a few minutes later.
61.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Trait_SoberKing"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Trait_SoberKing"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.HouseToras_Conquered"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn10_PalesReunification_NoDrink"] == false)

62.speaker: Narrator
62.text: The waiter nodded and brought Axel's drink a few minutes later.
62.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Trait_SoberKing"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Trait_SoberKing"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.HouseToras_Conquered"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn10_PalesReunification_NoDrink"] == false) == false)

64.speaker: Axel Reinhart
64.text: "Tell me... Are your family and the other royal houses really fine with your heirs bearing the Reinhart name?"

65.speaker: Narrator
65.text: We clinked our glasses and took a sip from our drinks.

66.speaker: Narrator
66.text: He raised his glass and then took a sip from it.

67.speaker: Axel Reinhart
67.text: "You know... My brother is quite mad about my decision to go along with this marriage. He thinks I've betrayed House Reinhart by giving my name away."

68.speaker: Player_Romus
68.text: "Of course they're fine with it. Because they have to be."

69.speaker: Player_Romus
69.text: "They were fine with the marriage, weren't they?"

70.speaker: Player_Romus
70.text: "Their opinions don't really matter. What matters is your union with Vina."

71.speaker: Player_Romus
71.text: "Heirs? Do you and Vina have something to tell me?"

74.speaker: Axel Reinhart
74.text: "Let alone all these talks of 'reunification'. It's making my family quite hostile towards me."

75.speaker: Player_Romus
75.text: "Do you think your brother will be a problem?"

76.speaker: Player_Romus
76.text: "Are you saying they're trying to block your efforts?"

77.speaker: Player_Romus
77.text: "I know how difficult it is to go against your own family, Axel. And you still did. I respect that."

79.speaker: Narrator
79.text: He let out a short laugh.

80.speaker: Axel Reinhart
80.text: "He had his chance to rule. If he hadn't taken the coward's way out, none of this would be happening."

81.speaker: Axel Reinhart
81.text: "Njolma's not the boss of me. I won't let this affect our cooperation."

82.speaker: Axel Reinhart
82.text: "Oh, they tried. But most of them don't even hold government positions anymore, the lazy bastards."

86.speaker: Narrator
86.text: He took a large sip from his glass.
86.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.BirthdayGathering_Target_StrikeHouseAzaro"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.BirthdayGathering_Target_StrikeHouseSazon"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.BirthdayGathering_Target_StrikeHouseToras"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.BirthdayGathering_Target_StrikeHouseToras"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.BirthdayGathering_Target_StrikeHouseToras"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.BirthdayGathering_Target_StrikeHouseSazon"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.BirthdayGathering_Target_StrikeHouseSazon"] == true) == false)

87.speaker: Axel Reinhart
87.text: "Tell me, how have your reforms been working out for Rizia? I see that the new government is already preparing for its first elections."
87.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Reform_Success"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Reform_Success"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Theocracy_Full"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.HouseOfDelegates_Abolished"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Order_Unrest_NationalDestabilization"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.BirthdayGathering_ViolentAction_DirectStrike"] == true) == false)

97.speaker: Axel Reinhart
97.text: "I am more concerned about the Rizian side of the equation."
97.conditionsRaw: Variable["RiziaDLC.Reform_Success"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Theocracy_Full"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.HouseOfDelegates_Abolished"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Order_Unrest_NationalDestabilization"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.BirthdayGathering_ViolentAction_DirectStrike"] == true

99.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
99.conditionsRaw: Variable["RiziaDLC.Reform_Success"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Theocracy_Full"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.HouseOfDelegates_Abolished"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Order_Unrest_NationalDestabilization"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.BirthdayGathering_ViolentAction_DirectStrike"] == true

100.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
100.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Reform_Success"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Theocracy_Full"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.HouseOfDelegates_Abolished"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Order_Unrest_NationalDestabilization"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.BirthdayGathering_ViolentAction_DirectStrike"] == true) == false

101.speaker: Axel Reinhart
101.text: "I'm just trying to wrap my head around the dynamics here in Rizia."

102.speaker: Axel Reinhart
102.text: "And how is this new religious rule of law faring for Rizia? It's a very different kingdom than when our negotiations began."
102.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Reform_Success"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Theocracy_Full"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Reform_Success"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Theocracy_Full"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.HouseOfDelegates_Abolished"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Order_Unrest_NationalDestabilization"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.BirthdayGathering_ViolentAction_DirectStrike"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.BirthdayGathering_ViolentAction"] == true) == false)

103.speaker: Axel Reinhart
103.text: "That was a drastic change. Abolishing the power of your council and empowering the parliament just like that..."

104.speaker: Player_Romus
104.text: "I'm not so fond of the new charter myself, but I had to do it for the Rizian people."

105.speaker: Player_Romus
105.text: "Times are changing, Axel. The days of kings leading armies on the battlefields are long gone."

106.speaker: Player_Romus
106.text: "Thank you, Axel. I had to take a lot of risks for this charter."

107.speaker: Player_Romus
107.text: "It was. The question is, do you respect that system yourself?"

108.speaker: Axel Reinhart
108.text: "Yes, of course. Governing Rizia is a much larger task than of Pales. I can't even imagine having direct control over such a large swath of land."

109.speaker: Axel Reinhart
109.text: "And how is the abolishment of your House of Delegates working out? You've taken quite a risk with that decision."
109.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Reform_Success"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Theocracy_Full"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.HouseOfDelegates_Abolished"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Reform_Success"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Theocracy_Full"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.HouseOfDelegates_Abolished"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Order_Unrest_NationalDestabilization"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.BirthdayGathering_ViolentAction_DirectStrike"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.BirthdayGathering_ViolentAction"] == true) == false)

110.speaker: Player_Romus
110.text: "I did what I had to do to keep Rizia running smoothly. The Delegates were only slowing us down."

111.speaker: Player_Romus
111.text: "I don't believe in their function, Axel. I'm just undoing the mistakes of my father."

112.speaker: Player_Romus
112.text: "Thank you, Axel. It was the right thing to do."

113.speaker: Player_Romus
113.text: "I did indeed. The question is, do you have a problem with that?"

114.speaker: Player_Romus
114.text: "Cosmetic changes only, Your Grace. Nothing to be concerned about."

115.speaker: Player_Romus
115.text: "I believe in enforcing the Divine's laws, Axel. I'm doing this for God and Rizian people."

116.speaker: Player_Romus
116.text: "Rizia is only beginning its transformation. I fully expect Pales to become part of our holy dominion as well."

117.speaker: Player_Romus
117.text: "Do you have a problem with that?"

122.speaker: Axel Reinhart
122.text: "May the Divine bless you, Your Majesty..."

124.speaker: Player_Romus
124.text: "Tell me, Axel. Would you consider yourself a devout Wruhecist?"

126.speaker: Axel Reinhart
126.text: "And how are you, Your Majesty? It's been a while since we last had a personal talk."
126.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Reform_Success"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Theocracy_Full"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.HouseOfDelegates_Abolished"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Reform_Success"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Theocracy_Full"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.HouseOfDelegates_Abolished"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Order_Unrest_NationalDestabilization"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.BirthdayGathering_ViolentAction_DirectStrike"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.BirthdayGathering_ViolentAction"] == true) == false)

127.speaker: Player_Romus
127.text: "Don't worry, son. We'll have all our lives to have many more of these talks."

128.speaker: Player_Romus
128.text: "I'm fine, thank you. A lot going on, as you know."

129.speaker: Player_Romus
129.text: "I don't like talking about my personal life, Axel."

133.speaker: Player_Romus
133.text: "If I may be honest with you, the recent unrest has been quite taxing."

135.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
135.conditionsRaw: Variable["RiziaDLC.Ending_Revolution"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Ending_Coup_Toras"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Ending_Coup_Sazon"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Ending_Coup_Azaro"] == true

136.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
136.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Ending_Revolution"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Ending_Coup_Toras"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Ending_Coup_Sazon"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Ending_Coup_Azaro"] == true) == false

137.speaker: Player_Romus
137.text: "It would be a lie if I'd said everything is great. But you know how it is."
137.conditionsRaw: Variable["RiziaDLC.Ending_Revolution"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Ending_Coup_Toras"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Ending_Coup_Sazon"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Ending_Coup_Azaro"] == true

142.speaker: Axel Reinhart
142.text: "You've got to talk about yourself at some point, or the gossip columnists will do it for you. That's my take, at any rate."

143.speaker: Axel Reinhart
143.text: "Hmm. You know best about these things."

146.speaker: Axel Reinhart
146.text: "I couldn't imagine how hard it was."

148.speaker: Axel Reinhart
148.text: "Besides, governing Rizia is a much larger task than ruling Pales. I can't even imagine having direct control over such a large swath of land."

152.speaker: Narrator
152.text: He took a few seconds to deliberate over his answer. Finally, he smiled.

157.speaker: Player_Romus
157.text: "I do not partake in the vice of alcohol consumption."

158.speaker: Axel Reinhart
158.text: "Uhm. As you wish. Then just the one glass of wine, please."

163.speaker: Player_Romus
163.text: "Derteans 25:17, reads, and I quote, 'The path of the righteous man is beset on all sides by sinful temptations of intoxicants and debauchery. I warn you, that those who live like this will be refused to walk the path of Golconda.'"

164.speaker: Narrator
164.text: He listened to me in shock as I recited the verse.

165.speaker: Axel Reinhart
165.text: "There's no text in Nurity that explicitly prohibits drinking alcohol, though."

166.speaker: Player_Romus
166.text: "Is this going to be a sticking point, Your Grace? My plan is to purge our unified kingdom of all sin, alcohol included."

167.speaker: Player_Romus
167.text: "There are many passages warning against it. I choose to heed that warning."

168.speaker: Player_Romus
168.text: "Your interpretation is completely false and ungrounded. May God forgive your ignorance."

169.speaker: Player_Romus
169.text: "Don't worry. You can drink whatever you want."

170.speaker: Player_Romus
170.text: "I mean it, Axel. If you are to be with my daughter, you have to stop drinking and strive to follow the path of Enlightenment."

171.speaker: Narrator
171.text: He did not respond for a few seconds.

173.speaker: Axel Reinhart
173.text: "I understand. I'll just have a glass of water."

174.speaker: Narrator
174.text: He looked relieved and gestured at the waiter.

175.speaker: Axel Reinhart
175.text: "Well, I choose not to. I'm sticking with my order."

176.speaker: Narrator
176.text: He then quickly gestured at the waiter.

182.speaker: Axel Reinhart
182.text: "We haven't had much of a chance to talk about Intermerkopum yet, have we?"

183.speaker: Axel Reinhart
183.text: "From what I'm hearing, few other countries expected such a bold move from Rizia, let alone Pales."

184.speaker: Axel Reinhart
184.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Intermerkopum_Failed"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Diplomacy_Intermerkopum"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Diplomacy_GRACEMember"] == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Diplomacy_Intermerkopum"] == true) == false)

186.speaker: Axel Reinhart
186.text: "But I think we're off to a very promising start. Although the Lespians are furious, as you can imagine."

187.speaker: Player_Romus
187.text: "Still, I'd rather try to have a good relationship with them."

188.speaker: Player_Romus
188.text: "Sooner or later, they will all have to realize and respect the power of Intermerkopum."

192.speaker: Axel Reinhart
192.text: "Lespia, for one, was immensely relieved when it didn't work out."

193.speaker: Player_Romus
193.text: "What did you expect? We took their favorite toy away from them."

194.speaker: Player_Romus
194.text: "Good. That means we are on the right track."

195.speaker: Player_Romus
195.text: "Still, I'd rather try to have a good relationship with them."

196.speaker: Player_Romus
196.text: "Don't tell me you're thinking about crawling back to Alvarez."

198.speaker: Player_Romus
198.text: "That means we were on the right track. We'll try again."

199.speaker: Axel Reinhart
199.text: "Alvarez should be the one trying to appease us now. Not the other way around."

201.speaker: Axel Reinhart
201.text: "We have make nice with Alvarez now, don't we?"

204.speaker: Narrator
204.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Intermerkopum_Failed"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Diplomacy_Intermerkopum"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Diplomacy_GRACEMember"] == false) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Diplomacy_Intermerkopum"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Diplomacy_Intermerkopum"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Diplomacy_Intermerkopum"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Diplomacy_GRACEMember"] == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Diplomacy_Intermerkopum"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Diplomacy_GRACEMember"] == false) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Diplomacy_GRACEMember"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Diplomacy_Pales_GRACEApplication"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["BaseGame.Rumburg_War"] == true) == false)

206.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
206.conditionsRaw: Variable["RiziaDLC.Lucita_Married"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Lucita_Arrested"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Lucita_Executed"] == false

207.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
207.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Lucita_Married"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Lucita_Arrested"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Lucita_Executed"] == false) == false

208.speaker: Narrator
208.text: On one of their visits, we decided to take a break and visit my hometown in Monqiz. Queen Consort Lucita joined us as well.
208.conditionsRaw: Variable["RiziaDLC.Lucita_Married"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Lucita_Arrested"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Lucita_Executed"] == false

210.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
210.conditionsRaw: Variable["RiziaDLC.Lucita_Married"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Lucita_Arrested"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Lucita_Executed"] == false

211.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
211.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Lucita_Married"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Lucita_Arrested"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Lucita_Executed"] == false) == false

212.speaker: Narrator
212.text: My eyes were on Vina and Lucita strolling along the beach. My wife stood behind my daughter as locals stopped and approached the Princess. She seemed to be immensely popular here.
212.conditionsRaw: Variable["RiziaDLC.Lucita_Married"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Lucita_Arrested"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Lucita_Executed"] == false

214.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
214.conditionsRaw: Variable["RiziaDLC.Lucita_Married"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Lucita_Arrested"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Lucita_Executed"] == false

215.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
215.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Lucita_Married"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Lucita_Arrested"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Lucita_Executed"] == false) == false

216.speaker: Axel Reinhart
216.text: "And how is your own marriage going, Your Majesty? Pregnancy suits the Queen Consort, it seems."

221.speaker: Narrator
221.text: He continued without waiting for my response.

222.speaker: Axel Reinhart
222.text: "Why would Rizia isolate itself from GRACE and Rumburg? It seems to me that you've lost your greatest support structure."

223.speaker: Player_Romus
223.text: "Oh, please. Rumburg and Rizia were never truly allies. The only thing keeping us together was a sham of an arranged marriage."

224.speaker: Player_Romus
224.text: "Rumburg is nothing but trouble, Axel. Rizia cannot afford to have such a close association with that kingdom anymore."

225.speaker: Player_Romus
225.text: "It wasn't my choice. When Queen Beatrice got wind of our intention to form Intermerkopum, she gave us the boot."

229.speaker: Player_Romus
229.text: "I see. Now that we can no longer get you into GRACE, you don't want to have anything to do with Rizia anymore."

232.speaker: Axel Reinhart
232.text: "Like the marriage you just arranged for your daughter?"

233.speaker: Axel Reinhart
233.text: "I see. A very vindictive woman, your sister-in-law."

236.speaker: Player_Romus
236.text: "She is my sister-in-law, which means nothing at all."

237.speaker: Player_Romus
237.text: "Well, yes. That's why I can afford to do this in the first place."

254.speaker: Axel Reinhart
254.text: "I'm surprised you never mentioned the true gravity of the situation around here."

255.speaker: Axel Reinhart
255.text: "Well... Not just here but the entire country. Revolutionaries are getting quite massive and violent from what I've been reading."

256.speaker: Axel Reinhart
256.text: "I'm surprised you've never mentioned the true gravity of the situation here in Rizia."
256.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Ending_Revolution"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Order_Unrest_NationalDestabilization"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Order_ViolentProtests_Valenqiris"] == true) == false)

258.speaker: Player_Romus
258.text: "You shouldn't trust everything you read in the newspapers."

259.speaker: Axel Reinhart
259.text: "Rizian revolutionaries have been getting quite massive, haven't they? Violent, even."

261.speaker: Player_Romus
261.text: "They can march wherever they want. The roads are not worn by walking."

266.speaker: Axel Reinhart
266.text: "Just don't forget. The same roads may lead them to you."

267.speaker: Axel Reinhart
267.text: "I seriously am concerned about the chaos, though. I'll be honest with you."

270.speaker: Axel Reinhart
270.text: "I want Vina to pause her regular travels back home until the danger is neutralized."

271.speaker: Player_Romus
271.text: "Why are you so concerned about this? There is no way Vina would be harmed here."

272.speaker: Player_Romus
272.text: "It seems to me like you're looking for an excuse."

273.speaker: Player_Romus
273.text: "I don't understand, Axel. What unrest are you talking about? We are on a beach, and as you can see, everything is fine."

274.speaker: Player_Romus
274.text: "I understand, Axel. But that is for Vina to decide, not you."

285.speaker: Narrator
285.text: He smiled and took another sip from his glass.

287.speaker: Axel Reinhart
287.text: "Either you are not being honest with me, or you are not aware of what's been happening."

288.speaker: Axel Reinhart
288.text: "I didn't mean to criticize or offend you at all. But as this concerns both my wife and my Grand Duchy, I hope you can get the situation under control."

292.speaker: Axel Reinhart
292.text: "Given some concerns of ours, as well as certain other changes that have occurred since my wedding to Princess Vina..."

293.speaker: Axel Reinhart
293.text: "Tell me. Can I trust that Rizia will take care of Pales as its own and respect our unique culture?"

294.speaker: Axel Reinhart
294.text: "I think it's time we strengthen our bonds and achieve this long-awaited reunification."

295.speaker: Axel Reinhart
295.text: "I've had some concerns, but in principle, I want to proceed with turning Rizia and Pales into a single kingdom."

299.speaker: Axel Reinhart
299.text: "One thing that bothers me, though, is the centralization of your regional system in Rizia."

300.speaker: Axel Reinhart
300.text: "If we were to be united, Palesian culture and traditions must be respected."

301.speaker: Axel Reinhart
301.text: "Tell me. Can I trust that Rizia will take care of Pales as its own while respecting us as a semi-autonomous region?"

302.speaker: Player_Romus
302.text: "Of course. We can definitely make an exception for Pales."

303.speaker: Player_Romus
303.text: "Yes, Axel. If that's your demand for unification, consider it done."

304.speaker: Player_Romus
304.text: "You can trust Rizia to take care of Pales as its own, but we cannot grant you special privileges. Once you unify with us, you will be a region of Rizia like any other."

305.speaker: Player_Romus
305.text: "No, Axel. We are not playing that game. You married my daughter, and now you're going to agree to unification."

306.speaker: Player_Romus
306.text: "Don't worry. Pales is of such enormous value to all of us. I will make sure it gets the attention it deserves."

307.speaker: Player_Romus
307.text: "No, Axel. We are not playing that game. You married my daughter already and now I need you to stop asking questions and agree to the unification."

313.speaker: Axel Reinhart
313.text: "I'm not sure if that's going to be enough."

316.speaker: Narrator
316.text: Realizing that I was being serious, he averted his eyes from me and sipped his drink again.

317.speaker: Narrator
317.text: He sighed and went quiet for a while.

325.speaker: Narrator
325.text: He looked at me with a huge smile on his face.

328.speaker: Axel Reinhart
328.text: "I just don't think Pales is ready."

329.speaker: Axel Reinhart
329.text: "I believe our countries should put the reunfication process on hold."

330.speaker: Axel Reinhart
330.text: "You know I'm not against it in principle. But now might not be the right time."

331.speaker: Player_Romus
331.text: "I understand. I hope we can regain your trust in the future."

332.speaker: Player_Romus
332.text: "Don't make us wait any longer, Axel."

333.speaker: Player_Romus
333.text: "Are you kidding me? After everything I've done?"

334.speaker: Player_Romus
334.text: "You seem not to understand the situation, Axel. I only sanctioned this marriage so that Rizia could get Pales back."

337.speaker: Axel Reinhart
337.text: "It's time the Princess and I were on our way back home."

338.speaker: Narrator
338.text: He finished the rest of his glass in one go and stood up, waving at Vina as he did so.

344.speaker: Axel Reinhart
344.text: "Once I'm back in Pales, I'll approve all the reunification documents and swear my undying fealty to the Rizian kingdom."

348.speaker: Player_Romus
348.text: "To new beginnings, and to the enduring strength of the bonds forged not by politics, but by hearts."

349.speaker: Narrator
349.text: He motioned for an embrace and we hugged.

350.speaker: Narrator
350.text: It was finally real. Pales was coming back home.

351.speaker: Axel Reinhart
351.text: "If you'll excuse me, I want to join Vina at the beach before the sun sets."

353.speaker: Axel Reinhart
353.text: "Sweetheart! Didn't you say you knew the perfect spot to watch the sunset? You simply must show me right this second."

354.speaker: Narrator
354.text: He abruptly stood up and walked away towards the sandy beach.

360.speaker: Player_Romus
360.text: "Speaking of preparations, shall we discuss our progress?"

362.speaker: Player_Romus
362.text: "Marrying Lucita was the only way to keep House Azaro happy. You know they're still disappointed we never invaded you a second time."

363.speaker: Player_Romus
363.text: "Our marriage is a mere footnote to yours. You and Vina are the future. Lucita and I are relics."

365.speaker: Axel Reinhart
365.text: "They're getting what they wanted, aren't they? Pales and Rizia, together at last."

366.speaker: Axel Reinhart
366.text: "Although I suppose if it went the way your wife's family envisioned, they'd be on my throne and I'd be facing the guillotine."

367.speaker: Axel Reinhart
367.text: "A second chance at fatherhood, at your age. It must feel like a gift from God."

368.speaker: Axel Reinhart
368.text: "I gave away the Reinhart name for this union, as you well know. And I am on the verge of giving up the Grand Duchy's hard-won independence."

373.speaker: Axel Reinhart
373.text: "I'm giving away the Grand Duchy's hard-won independence for this union, as you well know."

377.speaker: Narrator
377.text: Axel, seated next to me, looked out at the Antacean wistfully.

378.speaker: Narrator
378.text: The owner bowed deferentially several times in a row before rushing to set our places.

394.speaker: Axel Reinhart
394.text: "Overdone it lately, have you? I know the feeling. I'll have some water as well."

395.speaker: Axel Reinhart
395.text: "Oh, I see. This is some sort of test. Listen, Your Majesty, I enjoy a drink as much as the next man, but I assure you I'm no Patricio Alvarez. I'll have some water as well."

396.speaker: Axel Reinhart
396.text: "I'm speaking hypothetically, Your Majesty. For now."

397.speaker: Axel Reinhart
397.text: "I'm beginning to get the sense that's how it works in your kingdom. Whatever King Romus says, goes."
397.conditionsRaw: Variable["RiziaDLC.HouseOfDelegates_Abolished"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Theocracy_Full"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.BirthdayGathering_ViolentAction_DirectStrike"] == true

399.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
399.conditionsRaw: Variable["RiziaDLC.HouseOfDelegates_Abolished"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Theocracy_Full"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.BirthdayGathering_ViolentAction_DirectStrike"] == true

400.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
400.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.HouseOfDelegates_Abolished"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Theocracy_Full"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.BirthdayGathering_ViolentAction_DirectStrike"] == true) == false

401.speaker: Axel Reinhart
401.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.HouseOfDelegates_Abolished"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Theocracy_Full"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.BirthdayGathering_ViolentAction_DirectStrike"] == true) == false

403.speaker: Axel Reinhart
403.text: "No, no. That door has slammed shut."

404.speaker: Axel Reinhart
404.text: "Nobody will dare to toy with us now."

408.speaker: Axel Reinhart
408.text: "Nothing, Your Majesty. Just making small talk."

412.speaker: Axel Reinhart
412.text: "Why would Rizia isolate itself from GRACE? Right on the cusp of Pales becoming a member, no less."

413.speaker: Axel Reinhart
413.text: "But without the protection of GRACE or an alliance like Intermerkopum, our reunified kingdom will have to go it alone..."

414.speaker: Axel Reinhart
414.text: "Please, Your Majesty. I never said that."

419.speaker: Player_Romus
419.text: "Our partnership with Rumburg served its purpose. But now it is time for Rizia and Pales to forge our own way forward."

420.speaker: Axel Reinhart
420.text: "We'll have a hard time doing that without other allies, Your Majesty."

424.speaker: Axel Reinhart
424.text: "I have to thank you once more for getting Pales into GRACE, Your Majesty. Although the Lespians are furious about it, as you can imagine."
424.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Intermerkopum_Failed"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Diplomacy_Intermerkopum"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Diplomacy_GRACEMember"] == false) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Diplomacy_Intermerkopum"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Diplomacy_GRACEMember"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Diplomacy_Pales_GRACEApplication"] == true)

425.speaker: Axel Reinhart
425.text: "Nobody will dare to toy with us now."

427.speaker: Player_Romus
427.text: "Still, I'd rather try to have a good relationship with them."

428.speaker: Axel Reinhart
428.text: "Alvarez should be the one trying to appease us. Not the other way around."

431.speaker: Player_Romus
431.text: "Sooner or later, they will all have to realize and respect the power of our band of monarchies."

432.speaker: Axel Reinhart
432.text: "What's bad for Lespia is good for us."

433.speaker: Player_Romus
433.text: "What did you expect? We took their favorite toy away from them."

434.speaker: Player_Romus
434.text: "Good. That means we are on the right track."

438.speaker: Axel Reinhart
438.text: "I confess I don't like the rumors I'm hearing about an impending conflict between Rumburg and Sordland. I trust Pales would never be dragged into such a conflagration."

439.speaker: Player_Romus
439.text: "I'm sure it'll blow over. Nothing to worry about."

441.speaker: Player_Romus
441.text: "The members of GRACE must support each other, Duke Reinhart. If we don't come to Rumburg's aid in such a situation, they will never come to ours."

442.speaker: Player_Romus
442.text: "Trust me, I will do everything I can to keep Rizia and Pales out of such a conflict."

444.speaker: Axel Reinhart
444.text: "Have your butler read you a newspaper sometime, Your Majesty..."

445.speaker: Axel Reinhart
445.text: "That's the answer I was hoping for."

446.speaker: Axel Reinhart
446.text: "You would support Rumburg like you supported Vendonesam?"

458.speaker: Axel Reinhart
458.text: "One thing I did not expect from Rizia was your sudden coziness with Valgsland."

459.speaker: Axel Reinhart
459.text: "Caleqabiz, Your Majesty? You've practically put the Valgs at Pales' doorstep."

460.speaker: Player_Romus
460.text: "It was a necessary business arrangement. We would've lost control of the MITZ without it."

461.speaker: Axel Reinhart
461.text: "I am sure you had your reasons. But you've got to understand how this looks to my people."

462.speaker: Player_Romus
462.text: "This is not the Valgos Empire of old, Duke Reinhart. Hegel and his republic are different."

463.speaker: Player_Romus
463.text: "Do not disparage our Valgslandian comrades. We are all one people, fighting the good fight on behalf of the common man."

465.speaker: Axel Reinhart
465.text: "You were there at the AN. You heard what Hegel thinks of me."

466.speaker: Player_Romus
466.text: 'Your concerns are misplaced, Your Grace. Valgsland isn't planning anything."

467.speaker: Axel Reinhart
467.text: "Then why would they want a base so far south? Something here doesn't smell right."

474.speaker: Axel Reinhart
474.text: "I had my doubts at first -- especially when Mr. Esquibel stopped leading the reunification talks."

475.speaker: Axel Reinhart
475.text: "But my dear wife convinced me that both of our countries would be better off in the long run."

476.speaker: Axel Reinhart
476.text: "My wife sees it rather differently. Personally, though, I'm just happy you took her ex-paramour out of play."

477.speaker: Axel Reinhart
477.text: "King Valero was a man of many mistakes, I'll grant you that."

478.speaker: Axel Reinhart
478.text: "I'm not sure the House of Delegates was one of them. But I'll take your word for it."

479.speaker: Axel Reinhart
479.text: "My wife has her qualms, as I'm sure you're aware. Personally, though, I'm just happy you took her ex-paramour out of play."

482.speaker: Axel Reinhart
482.text: "We are still allies, Your Majesty. I still value and treasure our partnership."

variablesModified.value: "the United Kingdom of Rizia and Pales"
"the United Kingdom of Rizia and Pales, the Confederacy of Vendonesam"

489.speaker: Axel Reinhart
489.text: "The least that I can expect is that this... development won't interfere with the Princess of Rizia's birthright."

490.speaker: Player_Romus
490.text: "Look at all I've done for you. Isn't it enough to be part of a prospering alliance?"

491.speaker: Player_Romus
491.text: "I will be honest with you. I already promised to House Azaro that if my second child is a boy, he will succeed me."

493.speaker: Player_Romus
493.text: "The child could be a girl, in which case you have nothing to worry about. But if it is a boy, tradition dictates he will be my heir."

497.speaker: Player_Romus
497.text: "Birthrights don't mean much these days, Axel. Whether you're a prince or King Consort, your status will remain the same."

498.speaker: Narrator
498.text: He looked over at Lucita. She had met a young girl on the beach and was gleefully instructing her how to hold a stick as if it were a sword.
498.conditionsRaw: Variable["RiziaDLC.Lucita_Married"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Lucita_Arrested"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Lucita_Executed"] == false

499.speaker: Player_Romus
499.text: "You might as well come straight out with it. You're worried about losing your claim to the throne."

501.speaker: Narrator
501.text: He laced his fingers behind his head.

502.speaker: Axel Reinhart
502.text: "Hm. Yes, that's another thing I wanted to bring up with you..."

503.speaker: Axel Reinhart
503.text: "I do treasure our alliance. And I worry an Azaro heir on the throne will jeopardize it."

504.speaker: Axel Reinhart
504.text: "You yourself have broken royal tradition on a number of occasions. Why should this one mean so much to you?"

508.speaker: Axel Reinhart
508.text: "If Pales and Rizia are to forge a new kingdom together, we must put old traditions aside."

509.speaker: Player_Romus
509.text: "Vina is my eldest child. As far as I'm concerned, she is and will remain my heir."

510.speaker: Axel Reinhart
510.text: "Great. I hope Her Majesty isn't too put out about that."

514.speaker: Axel Reinhart
514.text: "And what of your own... unconventional partnership, Your Majesty?"
514.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Lucita_Married"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Lucita_Arrested"] == false  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.Lucita_Executed"] == false) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Pabel_RelationshipPublic"] == true)

515.speaker: Axel Reinhart
515.text: "It took real strength to come out and announce it like that. I've got to say I'm impressed."

516.speaker: Axel Reinhart
516.text: "And, well, I admit I'm relieved to know you won't be bearing any more children."

517.speaker: Player_Romus
517.text: "Come, now. Even if I was with a woman, I would never jeopardize Vina's inheritance."

518.speaker: Player_Romus
518.text: "Never say never. Like the metaphorical door between Pales and Rizia, this king swings both ways."

524.speaker: Axel Reinhart
524.text: "It's awfully hard to say no to Her Highness, isn't it?"

526.speaker: Player_Romus
526.text: "I'm too old to go through parenthood again, Axel. You two, on the other hand..."

528.speaker: Player_Romus
528.text: "No. And as a matter of fact, should reunification go as planned, you and Vina will inherit the Rizian throne *very* soon."

534.speaker: Axel Reinhart
534.text: "The topic has come up, Your Majesty. But we're in no rush."

535.speaker: Player_Romus
535.text: "Thank you. It wasn't easy, but I couldn't go on living a lie."

536.speaker: Axel Reinhart
536.text: "I hope your relatives will come around in time. It's as valid a lifestyle choice as any, if you ask me."

541.speaker: Axel Reinhart
541.text: "Especially after what happened at your mother's birthday."
541.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Reform_Success"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Reform_Success"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Theocracy_Full"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.HouseOfDelegates_Abolished"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.Situation_Order_Unrest_NationalDestabilization"] == true  or  Variable["RiziaDLC.BirthdayGathering_ViolentAction_DirectStrike"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.BirthdayGathering_ViolentAction"] == true)

545.speaker: Axel Reinhart
545.text: "However, the tactics you used to get these reforms passed struck me as highly concerning."

550.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
550.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.BirthdayGathering_Target_StrikeHouseAzaro"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.BirthdayGathering_Target_StrikeHouseSazon"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLC.BirthdayGathering_Target_StrikeHouseToras"] == true) == false

555.speaker: Player_Romus
555.text: "There was an emergency, but it was handled swiftly by the Rizian Crown."

556.speaker: Player_Romus
556.text: "Rizia is only beginning its transformation. I assure you there is nothing for Pales to worry about."

557.speaker: Player_Romus
557.text: "Do you have a problem with that?"

566.speaker: Axel Reinhart
566.text: "This is all stll hypothetical for now. But I hope you'll keep in mind that our alliance goes back further than yours and Her Majesty's."

570.speaker: Narrator
570.text: The waiter penciled down the order with shaking hands, then practically raced to the kitchen.
570.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Trait_SoberKing"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Trait_SoberKing"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.HouseToras_Conquered"] == true)

571.speaker: Player_Romus
571.text: "That's right, worm. Remember who owns these lands."

575.speaker: Player_Romus
575.text: "Why is everyone here so scared of me? They should be grateful I've purged the kingdom of traitors."

576.speaker: Player_Romus
576.text: "It's taking the province some time to adjust to the Crown's direct rule. I assure you, they'll be happier in the end."

577.speaker: Axel Reinhart
577.text: "Mm. Yes, seems like it's been quite the shake-up."

578.speaker: Axel Reinhart
578.text: "Mm. You must admit it's been quite the shake-up."

579.speaker: Narrator
579.text: Axel raised an eyebrow, but didn't say anything.

590.speaker: Narrator
590.text: The waiter returned with our drinks a few moments later.

591.speaker: Narrator
591.text: The waiter returned with Axel's drink a few moments later.

592.speaker: Axel Reinhart
592.text: "Ehm... Your Majesty, Rizia's provincial semi-autonomy was a large reason why I agreed to these reunification efforts."

593.speaker: Axel Reinhart
593.text: "The idea that the Crown can simply seize control of any province at any time... you'll excuse me if it doesn't sit right with me."

594.speaker: Player_Romus
594.text: "Relax, Your Grace. As long as Pales behaves itself, you'll never befall such a fate."

595.speaker: Player_Romus
595.text: "There was a plot to overthrow me. I did what I had to in order to protect Princess Vina's inheritance."

596.speaker: Player_Romus
596.text: "I promise you, this was strictly between me and the nobles in question. It won't go any further than that."

600.speaker: Player_Romus
600.text: "I acted in pure self-defense. Had I not, I wouldn't be sitting here talking to you right now."

601.speaker: Player_Romus
601.text: "Think about it, Axel. Thanks to me, House Azaro is no longer sitting at your doorstep. They'll never threaten Pales again."

602.speaker: Axel Reinhart
602.text: "All right. I suppose the inner workings of Rizia are still confusing to me."

603.speaker: Axel Reinhart
603.text: "We will behave ourselves. You won't have to worry about that."

610.speaker: Axel Reinhart
610.text: "I suppose I should be grateful about that..."

611.speaker: Axel Reinhart
611.text: "If there truly was not other option, then I cannot fault you."

612.speaker: Axel Reinhart
612.text: "Still, striking all three provinces at once? Not even my ancestor Otto would've tried to pull that off."

619.speaker: Player_Romus
619.text: "Relax. I myself enjoy a drink or two from time to time. I'll join you."
